results.title: Forged Merkle proof
results.threat: Claim a World ID root with an inclusion path that was never in the source block.
results.note: 0x0FD2 refuses inside the relay's own call, so the contract's BatchProofRejected is never reached.

results.title: Wrong contract called
results.threat: Relay a genuine, attested Sepolia transaction that did not call the World ID identity manager.
results.note: Sepolia tx 0x2e34a9030ece366901a54228bed260f20cedfd6db22253d005b0aaeb27e8c7cb: a USDC transfer, proved by the real 0x0FD2.

results.title: Reverted source transaction
results.threat: Relay a genuine transaction that failed on Sepolia, as if its state change had happened.
results.note: Sepolia tx 0x5f2664d6d3dfbaa6b01fa3bdd9754bc242d39269195bc49228cb19b3e936425d: receipt status 0, proved by the real 0x0FD2.

results.title: Replay an adopted root
results.threat: Submit a proof the relay has already consumed, to double-count a root or its reward.
results.note: Sepolia tx 0x366786038986b2f9e70e1fc1b2be3a419b7a4a3ef36732ed48bcd4083d058bb7, already relayed on CC3.

results.title: Roots out of order
results.threat: Batch a later source block before an earlier one to reorder the root chain.

results.title: Unattested block height
results.threat: Claim the transaction sits in a block Creditcoin's attestors have not signed yet.
expect: Error: Continuity proof does not match attestation or checkpoint
results.note: Height 11706750, 10,000 blocks past the attested tip 11696750.
results.error: Error: Continuity proof does not match attestation or checkpoint

results.title: Below the attestor floor
results.threat: Adopt a root while fewer bonded attestors back the source chain than the relay demands.
results.note: The live Sepolia relay bytecode, run at a scratch address with MIN_ATTESTORS raised from 3 to 1000; attestor count read from the real 0x0FD4.

results.title: Wrong source chain
results.threat: Feed a genuine Sepolia (staging) root into the Ethereum mainnet (Orb) relay.

results.title: Decoy TreeChanged log
results.threat: Append a fake TreeChanged event from another emitter to a real receipt.
results.note: The receipt is part of the proved leaf, so any added log breaks inclusion.

results.title: Oversize batch (11)
results.threat: Push eleven transactions through one call to exceed the gas the relay budgets for.

results.title: Root from before the history
results.threat: Introduce a genuine but old World ID root that does not chain onto anything the relay holds.
results.note: Sepolia tx 0x75303ecf5dce1420261aa7f8fd30194221bd5bf106fc008792ceb24a263bcbc5, a tree update from before this relay's first root.

results.title: One human, a second registration
results.threat: Register the same World ID nullifier again from the wallet already bound to it.
